# [MYYAML](https://djoezeke.github.io/myyaml) [ SECURITY POLICY ]

> [!NOTE]
> This policy is new and untested.
> We’ll update and polish it as we’re receiving security issues.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

> [!NOTE]
> If you have discovered a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately. **Do not disclose it as a public issue.** This gives us time to work with you to fix the issue before public exposure, reducing the chance that the exploit will be used before a patch is released.

We take the security of our project seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, we appreciate your help in disclosing it to us in a responsible manner.

When reporting, please include:

- A clear and concise description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the vulnerability.
- Any potential impact or exploit scenarios.
- If applicable, details about the environment where the vulnerability was discovered (e.g., operating system, browser, software versions).

Please disclose it at [security advisory](https://github.com/djoezeke/myyaml/security/advisories/new).

This project is maintained by a team of volunteers on a reasonable-effort basis. As such, vulnerabilities will be disclosed in a best effort base.
